arxiv-2301-00315.title: Parametric “Non-nested” Discriminants for Multiplicities of Univariate Polynomials 4 4 4 This paper has been accepted for publication in SCIENCE CHINA Mathematics.
arxiv-2301-00315.creator: Hong Hong, Jing Yang
arxiv-2301-00315.description: Abstract We consider the problem of complex root classification, i.e., finding the conditions on the coefficients of a univariate polynomial for all possible multiplicity structures on its complex roots. It is well known that such conditions can be written as conjunctions of several polynomial equations and one inequation in the coefficients.

arxiv-2311-18586.title: Local Minimizers of Nonconvex Functions in Banach Spaces via Moreau Envelopes
arxiv-2311-18586.creator: Pham Duy Khanh, Vu V.H. Khoa, Boris S. Mordukhovich, Vo Thanh Phat
arxiv-2311-18586.description: Abstract To Tamás Terlaky in honor of his 70th birthday with friendship and great respect Abstract. This paper investigates the preservation of local minimizers and strong minimizers of extended-real-valued lower semicontinuous functions under taking their Moreau envelopes. We address a general setting of Banach spaces, while all the obtained results are new even for functions in finite dimensions.

arxiv-2404-08722.title: VADA: a Data-Driven Simulator for Nanopore Sequencing
arxiv-2404-08722.creator: Jonas Niederle, Simon Koop, Marc Pagès-Gallego, Vlado Menkovski
arxiv-2404-08722.description: Abstract Nanopore sequencing offers the ability for real-time analysis of long DNA sequences at a low cost, enabling new applications such as early detection of cancer. Due to the complex nature of nanopore measurements and the high cost of obtaining ground truth datasets, there is a need for nanopore simulators.

arxiv-2411-17140.title: Crack Detection in Infrastructure Using Transfer Learning, Spatial Attention, and Genetic Algorithm Optimization
arxiv-2411-17140.creator: Feng Ding
arxiv-2411-17140.description: Abstract Crack detection plays a pivotal role in the maintenance and safety of infrastructure, including roads, bridges, and buildings, as timely identification of structural damage can prevent accidents and reduce costly repairs. Traditionally, manual inspection has been the norm, but it is labor-intensive, subjective, and hazardous.

arxiv-2510-17539.title: Volumetric Non-Invasive Cardiac Mapping for Accessible Global Arrhythmia Characterization
arxiv-2510-17539.creator: Jorge Vicente-Puig, Judit Chamorro-Servent, Ernesto Zacur, Inés Llorente-Lipe, Marta Martínez, Jorge Sanchez, Jana Reventós, Ivo Roca-Luque, Lluis Mont, Felipe Atienza, Andreu M. Climent, Maria S. Guillem, Ismael Hernández-Romero
arxiv-2510-17539.description: Abstract Introduction: Cardiac arrhythmias are a major cause of morbidity and mortality increasing the risk of stroke, heart failure, and sudden cardiac death. Imageless electrocardiographic Imaging has emerged as an accessible non-invasive alternative for cardiac electrical mapping from body surface potentials.

pmc-10698945.title: Association of GAB1 gene with asthma susceptibility and the efficacy of inhaled corticosteroids in children
pmc-10698945.creator: Yuxuan Zhang, Jun Liu, Yanjie Zhi, Xuan You, Bing Wei
pmc-10698945.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Asthma is a polygenic disease that may onset during childhood. Inhaled corticosteroids (ICS) are the main therapy in asthma, although their efficacy varies among individuals. Nuclear factor κB (NF-κB) is an important target of ICS treatment of asthma. Recent research has reported that GRB2 associated binding protein 1 (GAB1) gene may participate in the pathogenesis of asthma by regulating the NF-κB pathway.

pmc-11344546.title: Health Equity Considerations in Cost-Effectiveness Analysis: Insights from an Umbrella Review
pmc-11344546.creator: Jeffrey M Muir, Amruta Radhakrishnan, Ipek Ozer Stillman, Grammati Sarri
pmc-11344546.description: Cost-effectiveness analyses (CEA) are important in healthcare decision-making and resource allocation; however, expanding the scope of CEAs beyond the traditional clinicoeconomic concepts to also include value elements such as health equity has attracted much interest in recent years. This umbrella review aimed to synthesize evidence on how equity concepts have been considered in modified types of CEAs.

pmc-11358132.title: Experience shapes wild boar spatial response to drive hunts
pmc-11358132.creator: Astrid Olejarz, Evelina Augustsson, Petter Kjellander, Miloš Ježek, Tomasz Podgórski
pmc-11358132.description: Human-induced disturbances of the environment are rapid and often unpredictable in space and time, exposing wildlife to strong selection pressure favouring plasticity in specific traits. Measuring wildlife behavioural plasticity in response to human-induced disturbances such as hunting pressures is crucial in understanding population expansion in the highly plastic wild boar species.

pmc-11431882.title: Novel Function of Osteocalcin in Chondrocyte Differentiation and Endochondral Ossification Revealed on a CRISPR/Cas9 bglap–bglap2 Deficiency Mouse Model
pmc-11431882.creator: Xiang-Fang Yu, Bin Teng, Jun-Feng Li, Jian V Zhang, Zhe Su, Pei-Gen Ren, Consolato M Sergi, Angelo Ravelli, Luca Pio
pmc-11431882.description: Endochondral ossification is the process by which cartilage is mineralized into bone, and is essential for the development of long bones. Osteocalcin (OCN), a protein abundant in bone matrix, also exhibits high expression in chondrocytes, especially hypertrophic chondrocytes, while its role in endochondral ossification remains unclear.

pmc-12372777.title: Effects of the Generic Masculine and Its Alternatives in Germanophone Countries: A Multi-Lab Replication and Extension of Stahlberg, Sczesny, and Braun (2001)
pmc-12372777.creator: Hilmar Brohmer, Gabriela Hofer, Sebastian A Bauch, Julia Beitner, Jana B Berkessel, Katja Corcoran, David Garcia, Freya M Gruber, Fiorina Giuliani, Emanuel Jauk, Georg Krammer, Smirna Malkoc, Hannah Metzler, Hanna M Mües, Kathleen Otto, Rima-Maria Rahal, Mona Salwender, Sabine Sczesny, Dagmar Stahlb
pmc-12372777.description: In languages such as German, French, or Hindi, plural forms of job occupations and societal roles are often in a generic-masculine form instead of a gender-inclusive form. Although meant as ‘generic,’ this generic-masculine form excludes women from everyday language. Specifically, listeners and readers are less likely to think of women when this form is used.

pmc-12386705.title: Effects of Outdoor and Household Air Pollution on Hand Grip Strength in a Longitudinal Study of Rural Beijing Adults
pmc-12386705.creator: Wenlu Yuan, Xiaoying Li, Collin Brehmer, Talia Sternbach, Xiang Zhang, Ellison Carter, Yuanxun Zhang, Guofeng Shen, Shu Tao, Jill Baumgartner, Sam Harper, William A Toscano
pmc-12386705.description: Background: Outdoor and household PM2.5 are established risk factors for chronic disease and early mortality. In China, high levels of outdoor PM2.5 and solid fuel use for cooking and heating, especially in winter, pose large health risks to the country’s aging population.

pmc-12573277.title: Pattern of extra‐diaphragmatic respiratory muscle activity during exercise in patients with unilateral diaphragm dysfunction
pmc-12573277.creator: Antenor Rodrigues, Zafeiris Louvaris, Sauwaluk Dacha, Mayra Caleffi Pereira, Tin Gojevic, Michele R Schaeffer, Luc Janssens, Wim Janssens, W Darlene Reid, Ghislaine Gayan‐Ramirez, Dries Testelmans, Laurent Brochard, Rik Gosselink, Daniel Langer
pmc-12573277.description: Whether extra‐diaphragmatic respiratory muscle output is altered in patients with unilateral diaphragm dysfunction (UDD) remains unclear. We compared respiratory pressures and muscle activity during symptom‐limited cardiopulmonary exercise testing (CPET) in 10 patients with UDD and 10 matched controls. Ventilatory variables, dyspnea, and electromyography (EMG) of the diaphragm, scalene, sternocleidomastoid, and parasternal intercostals were assessed at iso‐ventilation and peak ventilation.

pmc-12581661.title: Rac1 palmitoylation is required for cardiac stress adaptation and regulation of protein kinase A signaling
pmc-12581661.creator: James P Teuber, Rachel E Scissors, Arasakumar Subramani, Nageswara Madamanchi, Matthew J Brody
pmc-12581661.description: Cardiac hypertrophy is a common adaptation to cardiovascular stress and often a prelude to heart failure. We examined how S-palmitoylation of the small GTPase, Ras-related C3 botulinum toxin substrate 1 (Rac1), impacts cardiomyocyte stress signaling. Mutation of the Cys-178 palmitoylation site impaired activation of Rac1 when overexpressed in cardiomyocytes.

pmc-12608616.title: Comparing Cytoreductive Nephrectomy with Tumor Thrombectomy Between Open, Laparoscopic, and Robotic Approaches
pmc-12608616.creator: Maxwell Sandberg, Gregory Russell, Phillip Krol, Mitchell Hayes, Randall Bissette, Reuben Ben David, Kartik Patel, Brejjette Aljabi, Seok-Soon Byun, Oscar Rodriguez Faba, Patricio Garcia Marchinena, Thiago Mourao, Gaetano Ciancio, Charles C Peyton, Rafael Zanotti, Philippe E Spiess, Reza Mehrazin, S
pmc-12608616.description: Simple SummaryThis study analyzes operative approach to cytoreductive nephrectomy with tumor thrombectomy, comparing open, laparoscopic, and robotic surgical techniques. It utilizes data from the Intercontinental Collaboration on Renal Cell Carcinoma database, which pulls patients from different continents or countries (North America, Central/South America, South Korea, and Spain), where all patients had a diagnosis of renal cell carcinoma with tumor thrombus.

pmc-13343123.title: Artificial intelligence in health systems of the WHO European region: implementation, applications, opportunities, and barriers
pmc-13343123.creator: Keyrellous Adib, Hanna Emilia Dunning, Nicholas Letchford, Nagui Salama, Yiannos Tolias, Jerome De Barros, Natasha Azzopardi-Muscat, Hans Henri P. Kluge, David Novillo-Ortiz
pmc-13343123.description: Highlights•AI has potential to improve health system quality and efficiency, but adoption remains uneven.•AI-powered diagnostics and conversational tools are the most widely used AI applications.•Legal uncertainty and affordability remain key barriers to wider adoption.•Stakeholder engagement exists but public involvement and training remain limited.

pmc-13389932.title: Comparison of a pharmacovigilance screening heuristic with expert clinical consensus for adverse drug reaction signal classification at a Pakistani tertiary care hospital
pmc-13389932.creator: Abdullah Umer, Abdul Basit Afzal, Sher Muhammad Sethi, Ainan Arshad
pmc-13389932.description: Background and Objective:Adverse drug reactions (ADRs) have a disproportionately higher burden in low- and middle-income countries where pharmacovigilance infrastructure is under-resourced. Electronic medical records (EMRs) can quantify drug-ADR associations but may require interpretive classification. We compared a statistical heuristic against expert clinical consensus for 82 drug-ADR signals from a Pakistani tertiary care hospital.
